answer: One importable reducer at platform/lib/completion_predicate.py:evaluate implements spec conditions 1-12 (COMPLETION-GATES.json gate A). This unit's catalog tests_required exercise conditions 1-10 as isolated UNSATISFIED mutants plus the three anti-patterns at spec line 10646. COMPLETE requires every applicable evaluated condition to be SATISFIED; NOT-CHECKED is a distinct outcome and never folds into SATISFIED (it yields INDETERMINATE). Exit code, a declared digest, and a path string are each structurally incapable of producing COMPLETE. Seven fan-in modules import the same evaluate object. SUCCESS:CC-0003
